name: Super Admin
description: Full unlimited access to every module, ERP settings, security rules, and staff management.

name: Admin
description: Operations and catalog manager with full permissions excluding security settings deletion.

name: Order Manager
description: Processes customer orders, assigns couriers, prints invoices, and performs fraud verification.

name: Inventory Manager
description: Controls warehouse stock, supplier entries, purchases, stock adjustments, and valuations.

name: Customer Support
description: Assists customers, inspects order histories, checks phone fraud risk, and handles reviews.

name: Marketing Manager
description: Manages banners, homepage sections, Meta Pixel, GTM, and website promotions.

name: Accountant
description: Inspects payment transactions, COD remittances, sales reports, and refunds.
